title: crm.book.company.updated
description: A company's fields were patched. `changed` names them. `name`, `status` and `owner_id` are the company's state after the patch.
$comment: Ahead of the producer (ADR-0020 slice I4): services/customer/app/services.py:update_company does not emit name, status, owner_id yet. Until that slice merges, a real payload fails this schema on exactly those fields. That is the forcing function, not a bug. Every other field is emitted today.
